Network Visibility Solutions by Use Case & Industry

Start from your problem or from your industry

Each solution page lists the tools, the features and the scenarios that apply.

Not sure where to start? Read one of the guides below, or talk to the ntop team.

Download free
Get a license
Talk to us

By need

Solutions by use case

Network Visibility and Monitoring

See every host, flow and application.

Network Performance and Observability

KPIs, latency and quality of experience across locations.

Threat Detection and Network Security

Detect anomalies, scans and suspicious communications.

Flow Collection and Traffic Analytics

NetFlow, sFlow and IPFIX at scale.

Capacity Planning and Troubleshooting

Find bottlenecks and plan growth with real data.

By sector

Solutions by industry

Internet Service Providers

Backbone, subscribers and DDoS defense.

Enterprise IT

Campuses, branches and the cloud in one console.

Cloud and Data Centers

East-west traffic and virtual workloads.

Manufacturing and Industrial

Passive OT and ICS monitoring.

Government and Critical Infrastructure

Self-hosted visibility and audit trails.

Mobile Operators

GTP visibility and subscriber experience.

Maritime

Control bandwidth at sea.

Learn

Guides

Open source network monitoring

What to look for and how to start for free.

Network traffic analysis software

Data sources, features and how to choose.

NetFlow, sFlow and IPFIX collector

How flow monitoring works and which tools you need.

TLS fingerprinting: JA3 and JA4

How fingerprints work and how nDPI reports them.

How to choose

Three steps to the right solution

  1. Pick the page that matches your problem (use case) or your sector (industry).
  2. Check the products listed on the page and the edition that fits your network size on the Pricing page.
  3. Install the free Community edition, or talk to us for a quote.

Get started

Tell us about your network

Download the free Community edition, compare editions and buy in the shop, or talk to the ntop team about your requirements.

Download free
Get a license
Talk to us
